ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the figure, within circle $O$, $AB$ is the diameter of circle $O$, and chord $CD$ is perpendicular to $AB$ at point H. If $AH=5$ and $HB=1$, then what is the length of $CD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Link $OD$, \\
$\because$ $AB$ is the diameter of the circle $\odot O$, and the chord $CD\perp AB$, \\
$\therefore$ $CD=2HD$, \\
$\because$ $AH=5$, $HB=1$, \\
$\therefore$ $AB=AH+HB=6$, \\
$\therefore$ $OD=OA=3$, \\
$\therefore$ $OH=AH−OA=2$, \\
In $\triangle ODH$, $DH=\sqrt{OD^{2}−OH^{2}}=\sqrt{5}$, \\
$\therefore$ $CD=2DH=2\sqrt{5}$, \\
Thus, the answer is: $CD=\boxed{2\sqrt{5}}$.
